narrator.role: NovaCloud HR system — warm, corporate, mildly passive-aggressive

alex.role: Alex, orientation buddy — chatty, over-caffeinated, genuinely helpful

security.role: Frank, Head of Security — stern, dry, secretly soft

segments.text: Welcome to NovaCloud. We're so glad you're here. We're also, regrettably, a little behind schedule.
Today is your first day. Your onboarding checklist has, technically, exploded. Don't worry. It happens.
Hey hey hey! It's Alex! Your orientation buddy! I left clues everywhere — sticky notes, posters, a thing in the lobby — you'll find them. I believe in you!
Frank. Head of Security. Bring the slip. Don't waste my time.
You have ten minutes to complete onboarding. Find your desk. Connect your workstation. Activate your badge. Meet your buddy. Boot your locker.
Finish, and you're cleared for cloud access. Plus swag. Mostly the swag.
Five minutes remaining. The HR system gently reminds you that orientation badges expire if not activated by end-of-day.
Heads up! Halfway! You're doing great! Probably! I can't actually see you, I'm in the break room!
Five minutes. The keypad doesn't get faster. You do.
Onboarding complete. All five steps cleared.
Welcome to the cloud. You're cleared for access.
YES! I knew it! Swag bag's at the door — t-shirt, stickers, two cold brews. Tell your friends. Tell strangers. Frank, we did it!
...Good work. Don't lose the badge. (Also: nice shirt.)
You're one of us now. Mostly. The probation period is six months. Welcome aboard.
Time's up. Onboarding window expired.
Don't worry — this happens to roughly forty percent of new hires. HR will reschedule.
Hey. HEY. You'll get it next time. I'll save you a cold brew. Probably. No promises.
Oh, and grab a sticker from the table on your way out. You showed up — that counts.
...You showed up. That's something. See you tomorrow.
Tomorrow, you'll be faster. The cloud is patient. Mostly.
